      r ()
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
    let raw1 ← verifier.BatchedWeights.new_loop weights val 0#usize
    ok (core.result.Result.Ok { «raw» := raw1, terms := 0#usize })
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      verifier.BatchedWeights (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::{aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::Accumulator}::new]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/verifier.rs', lines 93:4-93:180
    Visibility: public -/
def verifier.Accumulator.new
  (v : transport.Variant) :
  Result (core.result.Result verifier.Accumulator verifier.Error)
  := do
  let i ← transport.Variant.final_len v
  let q ← aspis_core.field.QM31.ZERO
  let r ←
    aspis_core.r0.heap.filled aspis_core.field.QM31.Insts.CoreMarkerCopy i q
  let r1 ←
    core.result.Result.map_err
      verifier.Accumulator.new.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleErrorError
      r ()
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
    let we ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ZERO
    let q1 ← aspis_core.field.QM31.ONE
    ok (core.result.Result.Ok
      { weights := val, rhs := we, power := q1, next := 0#usize })
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      verifier.Accumulator (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual

@[global_simps, irreducible] def compact.SPLIT : Std.Usize := 10#usize

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::candidate::tx1]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/candidate.rs', lines 270:0-291:1
    Visibility: public -/
def verifier.candidate.tx1
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (public1 : aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public)
  (public_bytes : Slice Std.U8) (proof : Slice Std.U8) (k : Std.Usize)
  (hash : H) (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit)) :
  Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) verifier.Error)
  := do
  if k != compact.SPLIT
  then ok (core.result.Result.Err verifier.Error.Parse)
  else
    let r ← verifier.candidate.parse_shape proof
    let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
    match cf with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
      let r1 ← verifier.candidate.canonical_scan proof
      let cf1 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
      match cf1 with
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
        verifier.mark obs verifier.Phase.Parsed
        let we ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ZERO
        let g := Array.repeat 29#usize we
        let (r2, g1) ←
          verifier.candidate.prepare aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst public1 proof
            hash obs g
        let cf2 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r2
        match cf2 with
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
          let r3 ← verifier.Accumulator.new transport.Variant.S2
          let cf3 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r3
          match cf3 with
          | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val1 =>
            verifier.mark obs verifier.Phase.Prepare
            let i ← compact.OFF_FOLDED_ROOT
            let i1 ← compact.OFF_ROUND1
            let s ←
              core.slice.index.Slice.index
                (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8) proof
                { start := i, «end» := i1 }
            let r4 ←
              core.array.TryFromArrayCopySlice.try_from 32#usize
                core.marker.CopyU8 s
            let folded_root ←
              core.result.Result.unwrap core.fmt.DebugTryFromSliceError r4
            let r5 ←
              verifier.candidate.batch_merkle aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst
                proof val folded_root 0#usize hash
            let cf4 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r5
            match cf4 with
            | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
              verifier.mark obs (verifier.Phase.Merkle 0#usize)
              let r6 ← verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range val.queries 0#usize k
              let cf5 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r6
              match cf5 with
              | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val2 =>
                let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref val1.weights
                let r7 ← verifier.BatchedWeights.new s1
                let cf6 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r7
                match cf6 with
                | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val3 =>
                  let r8 ←
                    verifier.candidate.query_loop proof val val1 g1 obs val2
                      val3 k
                  let cf7 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r8
                  match cf7 with
                  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val4 =>
                    let (a, pending) := val4
                    let (s2, deref_mut_back) ←
                      lift (alloc.vec.Vec.deref_mut a.weights)
                    let s3 ← verifier.BatchedWeights.finish pending s2
                    let v := deref_mut_back s3
                    let bytes ←
                      verifier.checkpoint aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst val
                        { a with weights := v } proof public_bytes hash
                    verifier.mark obs verifier.Phase.CheckpointWrite
                    ok (core.result.Result.Ok bytes)
                  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
                    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
                      (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) (core.convert.FromSame
                      verifier.Error) residual
                | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
                  core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
                    (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) (core.convert.FromSame
                    verifier.Error) residual
              | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
                core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
                  (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error)
                  residual
            | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
              core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
                (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error)
                residual
          | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
            core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
              (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error)
              residual
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
            (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error)
            residual
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
          (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error)
          residual
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
        (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual

end AspisR1CurrentCaller
